notes.title: Gray's DLC and Aiden's full route
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

I was hoping to have Gray's DLC and Aiden's DLC up on Steam before the end of the year. Sadly, I didn't make it. I still need to write Aiden's side story before I can push out a new update for the game. Gray's side story is already finished at the very least.

I didn't want to release Gray's DLC without Aiden's DLC as well. I will be aiming for [b]early 2024[/b] to have them both released! Again, all that's left is an Aiden side story to wrap up his full route and DLC.

Meanwhile, I've been working on Eeyok's route, which currently has 10 coded and playable chapters, available on the [url=https://www.patreon.com/celianna]Patreon[/url].

Happy holidays everyone, see you next year!

notes.title: An upcoming otome game: Moonstone Remix
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33749662/8157c788666c24ef1b39a51ba9ab17b5bcc335f0.png[/img]

With Tailor Tales completed (don't worry, Gray's DLC and Aiden's full route will be coming in the future, and Eeyok's route is still being worked on), it is time to work on my next game; [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2640220/Moonstone_Remix/]Moonstone Remix.[/url]

A lot of players mentioned that they enjoyed playing Aiden's route because they really liked the Chaos Chat interactions. They enjoyed how immersive it felt, and even if they didn't particularly liked Aiden himself, they enjoyed the chatting and interacting with friends.

Moonstone Remix takes that concept and runs with it; it's a fully fledged chat simulation game. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33749662/2b3894baf02fd9db5161dd7d1a5af42e784f8f3b.png[/img]

You will end up playing a fake MMORPG (a game within a game!) where you will meet other players. You can party up with these players and eventually form friendships with them. You can then interact with them outside of the game through a chatting app called Chaos Chat. Here you can befriend or romance them - and even ask them to meet up with you in person!

There will be 6 main characters to date from the start, but many more other secondary characters will be added as well.

There will be a lot of character customization available, as I want the player to feel as immersed as possible. From your name, looks, gender, to the emojis you use in the chat. Everything is up to you.

If you enjoyed Tailor Tales, make sure to [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2640220/Moonstone_Remix/]wishlist Moonstone Remix[/url] as well!

notes.title: Gray the heart stealer out now!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33749662/b8fe22388d39944a7bdcdec18ce4b94eca31d094.png[/img]

It's here, Gray's route is finally out and available to play! Go to the Settings in the main menu, select Characters and choose Gray from the list, then click on [i]start new route[/i] and you're all set.

Gray's route opens with JOselina in her high school years, where she is the school's gang leader. Coincidentally she meets Gray from a rivaling school. After a dramatic event, Joselina swears off gang activities forever, but everything comes rushing back when she meets Gray again all those years later...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33749662/029f00be07fde931d5681b4ebf40baf6f00fb679.png[/img]

James' Plus DLC has also dropped! You can now purchase his Plus DLC and enjoy his longer epilogue which contains 2 CGs! It also comes with a cute side story about spending his first Christmas on earth.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1784031/Tailor_Tales__James_Plus/]Get James' Plus DLC here.[/url]

[h1]Aiden Jager[/h1]
Along with Gray's full route, Aiden's first 9 chapters are also available to play! Aiden's route is unique from the rest; his full route is only available through his Plus DLC due to the amount of sexual content present in the story. His Plus DLC will be available sometime in the future, no ETA yet.

notes.title: Gray's route completed

Gray's route has been completed! While it's fully playable and all artwork is done, I am currently making Gray's route undergo some editing based on player feedback. As much as I wanted to release it in 2022, I think it's important to release a version that I'm satisfied with. This means some chapters will be slightly changed.

When the editing is completed, Gray's route will be released on Steam for players to enjoy and play in full.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33749662/d9a8cb31c0027e76146101d707ff5006f78c801c.png[/img]

When Gray's route is released on Steam, Aiden's chapters 1 through 9 will be released alongside as well. This is because Aiden's route is a special case; you need the DLC to fully play his route. Why? Because after chapter 9, his route is full of 18+ content, that couldn't be released for free users.

Aiden's route and DLC should be coming sometime in 2023.

[h1]James' DLC[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33749662/222da36b37cb3951a8093298bcd46880ca18be42.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33749662/264045b6be59c7276d6a6dc132c8cc4d98acdf28.png[/img]

notes.title: Tailor Tales Plus DLC
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33749662/29ab979affb3d2ad58daee686636656727ce3d56.png[/img]

The Tailor Tales Plus DLC is here! You can now purchase the Plus version of these characters:

[list]
[*] [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1206450/Tailor_Tales__Neil_Plus/]Neil[/url]
[*] [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1206451/Tailor_Tales__Dimitri_Plus/]Dimitri[/url]
[*] [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1784030/Tailor_Tales__Caine_Plus/]Caine[/url]
[/list]

[b]What is Tailor Tales Plus?[/b]
Tailor Tales Plus unlocks the adult content of the game, as well as any side stories for each character. The epilogue for each Plus character will have a scene containing sexual content, including the final CG for them. Some Plus characters have sexual content throughout the chapters, these are marked as "plus" in the chapter selection. As an extra perk, you can skip chapter requirements for ALL characters (even those you do not have the DLC for), though you can always turn this back on if you enjoy a challenge.

[b]What about other characters?[/b]
Plus DLC for other characters such as James, Gray and Aiden will be released on another date in the future.

notes.title: James released
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33749662/f6d39959e08da8df4834895c52f035cc581b70f1.png[/img]

James is out now!

[previewyoutube=VHDf3Uh5S7w;full][/previewyoutube]
[b]In an alternate world where people have superpowers, Joselina (you) has one of her own. However, instead of fighting crime, she uses it to create superhero suits for the actual superheroes. One day during an attack on the city, a superhero crash lands in front of her boutique and she saves him.

…But he isn’t a hero – he’s a villain.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33749662/d291682c82ac2621add69bb3f1904aa44d665f94.png[/img]

James has a unique perk where your name gets voiced if it belongs to one of the 200 names [url=https://docs.google.com/document/d/1EUZw6jENbS9YhpcbK4sajgLdj6fIcHoTUR_ZYHR4-uc/edit?usp=sharing]on this list[/url], including the default name.

[h1]Starting James' route[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33749662/982831f205455d3cf2affe4914b0e2a84e4e5959.png[/img]

Let the update run its course, then load your manual save file. You can access James' route by clicking the cogwheel for Settings, click Characters and select James. Here you can start a new route.

[h1]James walkthrough[/h1]
James, just like any other character, requires important clients to be finished for specific chapters. If you need help figuring those out, you can view his walkthrough below:
[previewyoutube=sliActFGMQQ;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]James Plus[/h1]
The last two CGs for James are Plus content only, so free users are not able to unlock those last two CGs. James' Plus will be available as DLC in the future, no ETA yet.

[h1]Achievements[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33749662/cb2e6c07dc109d7674044626c20c65f946001438.png[/img]

You may notice a stream of achievements being unlocked once you load the game. Tailor Tales now has in-game achievements that grant you an outfit. You can wear these by going to Outfits and finding them in the appropriate categories. To view your achievements, click the Collection icon in the settings.

[h1]Gray & Aiden[/h1]
The upcoming two routes, Gray and Aiden, are currently in development. You can try out their first chapter by rereading them in their chapter selection for a preview! Their release dates are set sometime 2022.


[h1]7th route[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33749662/9dd9ee9ee02347c3a21566d3ea82fd3522e622d8.png[/img]

As voted by Patrons, the 7th route will be Eeyok Dougenis. Set in the 18th century, Eeyok's route deals with high society, magic and time traveling. Tailor Tales features routes with unique stories and settings, and Eeyok's route isn't any different.

[h1]Technical support[/h1]
In the event you run into an error, such as a missing file, please validate your files before doing anything else. Sometimes the update doesn't complete 100% and Steam misses a file. You can fix this by finding Tailor Tales in your Steam library, right clicking it and selecting properties. Then go to the local files tab, and select "Verify integrity of game files" to let Steam fix any missing files.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33749662/984bede8eb282386fe67b71f5498b57d10e39c20.png[/img]

Please note Tailor Tales does NOT support cloud saving, so reinstalling the game does mean you will lose your progress.

Any bugs can be reported in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/939330/discussions/0/5208960061388718271/]Steam thread[/url], or on [url=https://discord.gg/Hh5RGA3]Discord[/url]. Discord is the fasted way of getting help.

notes.title: James - The Villain
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33749662/ce630402bf450506b926346fda5ad8d50f564dbd.png[/img]

James is finally arriving to Steam on July 18, 2021!

James is unlike the other routes in Tailor Tales, being twice as long and focusing on fantasy elements this time around. Each route in Tailor Tales is unique, which is definitely represented with James. It will take roughly 10 to 12 hours to complete his route.

[b]Route synopsis[/b]
In an alternate world where people have superpowers, Joselina (you) has one of her own. However, instead of fighting crime, she uses it to create superhero suits for the actual superheroes. One day during an attack on the city, a superhero crash lands in front of her boutique and she saves him.

…But he isn’t a hero – [i]he’s a villain.[/i]

notes.title: Small fixes
notes.content:
A small update! This should render your current quick save file useless, so please make sure you load your manual save file when starting the game. You can always make a new quick save!

[b]What's been changed:[/b]
- Deleting a piece of clothing no longer deletes the image on your hard drive, preventing any future issues with missing clothing files.
- A warning will now display when attempting to load from a quick save file that is [b]older[/b] than your manual save (this is your main save!), meaning you might lose progress if you continue to play from your quick save file.
- Neil's gotten a new voice actor and his lines have been added, replacing the old VA!

And that's it for the update!

As for an update on James' route progress, I would estimate his script is about 85% finished, and playable chapters are currently sitting at 20 out of 28. Development should be finished around December or early 2021, with an actual update being pushed out in mid 2021 with his completed route.

notes.title: Ending title card achievements fixed
notes.content:
This is a small update to fix the achievements for the ending titles (Dominatrix, Playful, Patient, Angelic) not unlocking.

Players who have completed a character route and gotten their achievements, but never got the above named achievement(s), they will have to manually unlock any achievements they may have missed out on.

Please go to your main menu and click the cogwheel to open the settings. Click the gift button and enter the password "achievement" to unlock the achievements you got on Steam! This will only grant you the achievements you have legitimately unlocked, so it is not a cheat code of some sorts :)

Sorry for the inconvenience! Steam achievements are an uphill battle.

The game has been updated to version 3.0.6, which is a small update.

This includes new backgrounds to use during the camera mode when taking screenshots of your outfit. As well as some balancing issues with the cost for chapters when you have high tailoring exp.

Fixed a few typos as well!

Please let me know of any issues.

notes.title: Caine Prins now available
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33749662/840a5df2407d7dce538bfd7cc2677d18a7f0ce34.png[/img]

Caine's route is finally out! Go ahead and update your game, load your manual save file (your quick save file won't work, but it's okay, you can always create a new quick save!) and find Caine in the settings. Click on his profile and select "start new route" and you're on your way!

For those curious, James' 1st chapter is available to be read as well. You can't start a new route with him, but you can reread his 1st chapter as it is unlocked for you.

[b]Caine's walkthrough for important clients:[/b]
https://youtu.be/u23sJbT2dRs

[h2][b]A full changelog of updates below:[/b][/h2]

[b]Content[/b]
- Caine's full route has now been added (5 hours of content)
- James' 1st chapter can be previewed (go to chapter selection, then reread his 1st chapter)
- A whole bunch of new clothing accessories are now available
- New clothing styles for tops and skirts have been added
- Geometric shapes are available as details
- Lots of new patterns to use
- New wallpaper, flooring and furniture to customize your boutique
- MC now has a sprite that has been added for side stories told in the love interest' point of view (Plus users only)

[b]Bugfixes[/b]
- Fixed a save file corruption error that would sometimes occur when the player tried to load their save file again, leading to an error saying "Cannot read property 'name' of null"
- Fixed a few layer issues with clothing that wouldn't load when you first entered the designing screen
- Some GPUs would cause an error with the screen after alt-tabbing and going back to the game where the screen was frozen, which has now been fixed
- Sprites now fade in and out without seeing the underlying layers
- Fixed a bug where you could select invisible colours when picking out a background for the camera mode
- Some players would get errors with patterns displaying incorrectly. This issue was traced to the web-GL functionality being disabled on the user' computer. If the user cannot turn web-GL back on themselves, they must switch out their package.
- After completing a route, players were asked if they wanted to read the other ending, but were sometimes met by the same ending regardless. It'll now set the chapter back to 25 properly so you can choose which ending to read

[b]New features[/b]
- All text messages have been replaced by a phone system that can show emojis and pictures as well
- Players can change the size of the text to small, medium and large by clicking the AA icon
- Players can now date characters after completing their route (Plus users only)
- Dynamic tinting to account for the surroundings or time of day (orange during sunset, dark during night etc.)
- Background blurring whenever a character approaches you has been remade and looks blurrier
- Screen effects such as dashes, lights, and action lines have been added
- The Profile in the settings of the main menu has been reworked to add a few more options
- Players can now determine whether they're a virgin or not in the main menu, under Profile. Some routes (namely Caine) has slightly different dialogue based on this choice
- Players can determine whether they want to hear MC's soundbites during side stories or not in the main menu under settings
- Starting a new route, you'll be asked if you want to view the warnings and triggers for that route. Major spoilers are still hidden, so if you accidentally click yes, you will not be spoiled
- You can rename your brother (Ralph), who appears in James' route. His sprite will take on the MC's CG colours

[b]Artwork[/b]
- A few backgrounds were redrawn
- Gray, previously named Sam, has been reworked
- Aiden and Neil has had some minor updates to their sprites
- Some of Neil's CGs were redrawn
- Some of the clothing has been redrawn, namely the midi and maxi circle skirts
- A couple of hairstyles were redrawn

[b]Misc.[/b]
- The introduction tutorial has been remade and spread out as to not overwhelm new players. Returning players may stumble upon a tutorial here and there
- All soundbites have been organized into subfolders
- All backgrounds are now organized into a subfolder
- Some quality of life fixes (more colours grouped, certain clothing elements excluded from being randomized)

notes.title: Caine's route releasing on March 25
notes.content:
Caine's route is finally ready to be released! On March 25 the game will get updated with his full route, along with a load of improvements and bug fixes to the game.

When this update happens, your quick save will become unusable, so please be sure to load your manual save. New quick saves can be made after this update.

The tutorial from the intro has also been changed, so old users may run into a few tutorials here and there.

Anyways, be on the lookout for Caine! He'll be there to steal your heart away. Clocking in at 135k words (125k words for free users), or around 5 to 6 hours of playtime, he is the longest route to date.

notes.title: Caine's route coming early 2020!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33749662/273e2da70a19f199632e61a9c6801e47aec199ed.png[/img]

Caine's route was officially completed in September 2019. Early access was available to Patreons only. Which means that he'll be released for free in early 2020! For an exact date, be sure to follow on social media such as [url=https://twitter.com/Celianna_C]Twitter[/url] for any announcements.

With Caine's route being completed, James' route has been underway. It is roughly one year per character, so you can expect a 2021 release for James. Patreons are already enjoying his 1st chapter. Here's a screenshot of his first chapter, featuring MC's brother Ralph (nameable!), and an older Caine.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33749662/a196dde51c1085cd6a00388d489fbb01858d4afd.png[/img]

When Caine's route gets released, it'll come with a bunch of new features and updates such as dynamic tinting. Character sprites are now tinted darker or more orange to reflect the time of day.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33749662/e527bd28e39c5d3fd1b94a85ca6c82d8172630c3.png[/img]

A new phone message system was coded. All texting conversations have been converted to use this new system. Characters will type messages to you and you'll see them type in real-time. They'll use emojis and even send you selfies. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33749662/56b33a674b3ad7d62a99952ea4a4813f39a23ce8.png[/img]

Check it out in action in this video:
[previewyoutube=_VJwORna7XY;full][/previewyoutube]

A trigger warning screen before you start each route, with the option to skip. Heavy spoiler warnings are hidden behind a wall, so no worries - you won't be spoiled if you are curious to check out the regular warnings.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33749662/51f626c9f7a58e6668811dfa139e7545567dbd97.png[/img]

You can now select whether or not your MC is a virgin in the main menu. This will influence certain stories, but not all. For example, it will come up in Caine's route and influence his ending.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33749662/9308f74f56fc7027a02f15d9ef44b7d946e87d71.png[/img]

Small visual updates on Neil's sprite.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33749662/5be44c74d5a0b28af88b815e016f3d8ff2ee2424.png[/img]

And of course, a bunch of new items for dressing up your avatar, which you'll get to find out for yourself.

[h1]Plus?[/h1]
With Caine's route completed, it's about time that the Plus DLC will become available on Steam as well. I will be working hard to add the Plus DLC for Neil and Dimitri on Steam after Caine is released. Caine's Plus DLC will not be available until James is released, so for now it remains a Patreon exclusive.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33749662/b7d7617fc75b91e6bfa35adb63c583e3e2eff2d9.png[/img]

The new update is here, and with it, an added new feature to the game! You can now see a checklist for clients, which will tell you what is correct and incorrect about your design. This way, you no longer have to wonder why the design isn't accepting, even though it looks identical.

This also fixes a bug where, if you had selected a colour/pattern of an optional category such as a hemline, even though the hemline wasn't selected itself, then the design wouldn't accept it - despite looking identical to what the client wants. Now you can accidentally click any colour/pattern and it won't count for the design until you select an actual hemline or sleeves etc.

This will be the last update made to the game until Caine's route is completed.

notes.title: Tailor Tales out!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33749662/d286ab86b4d2f84bf59ef55fa9e373134f82359d.png[/img]
[h1]Tailor Tales is now officially out![/h1]

Neil and Dimitri's route are fully playable.

To celebrate the release, there will be a bonus for early birds of the game.

Go to your in-game Settings > Gift > type in the password [i]"earlybird"[/i] to receive some extra gold and tailoring experience to start you off with!

There is also a bonus preview of Caine's 1st chapter, for the curious ones. Simply go to Settings > Character > Caine > Story > Click his 1st chapter and select "reread".

Happy playing!
